name.description: The exposure's slug, or `assets` or `job_history` for the capabilities that belong to the robot as a whole.

kind.description: The kind of access the capability needs.

granted.description: Whether the role may use it: its requirement is met and the app has not locked it.

requirement.description: The role keys that qualify, from the entry, the rule or the default that decided. Holding one of them, or inheriting from one, is enough. Empty when nobody qualifies.

source.description: Where the requirement came from: `entry` is the entry's own `role`, `rule` the first matching rule of `access.rules`, `robot` the robot's `access.assets` or `access.job_history`, and `org_default` the organization's default for the kind.

rule_index.description: For `rule`, the position of the deciding rule in `access.rules`, counted from zero; `null` otherwise.

satisfied_by.description: The key from `requirement` that the role holds through inheritance. `null` when the role is named in the requirement itself, and when it does not meet the requirement at all. Independent of locks.

locked.description: Whether the app locks this capability, as a kind or as a single lock. A lock wins over the requirement.

unknown_roles.description: Keys in the requirement that name no role of the organization. They grant nothing.
